notes.scope: Relevant fields of Detections; one tensor per image, not a JSON object. This is the AutoShape wrapper output, not the raw network forward output.
notes.columns: All rows end in confidence, class. pred and xyxy begin x1,y1,x2,y2 in original pixels. xywh begins center_x,center_y,width,height in pixels. The n-suffixed views divide x/width by image width and y/height by image height.
notes.ids: Class IDs occupy floating tensor entries; use names for their meaning.
notes.empty: An image without detections has a zero-row tensor, not a missing batch entry.
notes.representation: Nested arrays describe the batch list and per-image tensor rows. They do not indicate JSON serialization. names is a class-index dictionary or an index-ordered list of class names, depending on the loaded model.
notes.numeric_storage: Box tensors store floating-point entries, including class and tracking IDs. Those ID columns are declared integer because that is their expected safe cast target. Storage precision depends on the producer/runtime; consumers must preserve ID values during conversion.
